tonight.headline: Still ahead on paper; Warren's shoulder is the one thing that can undo it
body: Week 3 hasn't started. ESPN projects you 134.5 to Footballers' 120.1, a 57% win probability. Nothing on your roster plays tonight; Footballers' Christian Watson does.
The bad news first: Warren was limited again on Thursday. You don't need to do anything today. Check Friday's Steelers report. Tuten covers him and kicks off at the same time.

case.label: Their lineup
case.body: Footballers start Matthew Stafford because Caleb Williams didn't practise Thursday (NBC Sports). Brock Bowers is questionable, but he's practising and aiming to make his season debut against New Orleans after a meniscus trim (CBS Sports, 21 Sep). If he plays, their 120.1 is real.

case.label: Where you could lose it
case.body: Your 14-point edge assumes Warren plays. Steelers Depot (24 Sep): limited Thursday with the shoulder, and 'has a better chance to play Sunday than Dowdle', who didn't practise. If Warren sits and nobody moves Tuten in, that slot scores zero and most of the edge goes with it.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Warren is listed OUT or DOUBTFUL on Friday and Tuten isn't moved in before 11:00 Sunday. Or Bowers plays a full role and Footballers outscore their projection by more than 14.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · NBC Sports · CBS Sports · Steelers Depot

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only. Check Friday's Steelers report; both kick off Sunday 11:00 Mexico City
doFirst.title: Only if Pittsburgh rule Warren out: start Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: Not armed. Don't do this today. Warren starts unless Friday's report lists him OUT or DOUBTFUL.

case.label: The evidence, now two days of it
case.body: Warren was limited Wednesday and limited again Thursday with the shoulder (Steelers Depot, 24 Sep). Limited both days is not the pattern of a player about to be ruled out. Rico Dowdle didn't practise Thursday (toe), and Pittsburgh may elevate Travis Homer for depth. If Warren plays, the backfield is his.

case.label: Why a card and not a note
case.body: This is the Pitts lesson: when a startable back-up is sitting on the bench, it gets a card, not a footnote. Tuten leads Jacksonville's backs in snaps and carries (SI, 24 Sep).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: By projection it's Warren 15.0 to Tuten 11.0. Swapping on a 'limited' tag throws away four points. The matchups don't change that: Cincinnati have allowed the 7th-fewest RB points and New England the 9th-fewest (footballdb, two games). Both kick off at 11:00 Sunday, so there's no timing trap.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Warren practises fully on Friday. The card then never fires and costs nothing.

action.label: Start Tuten · bench Warren (only if Warren is ruled out)

whatWentWrong.title: The last fallback card in this league got used, and it took your defence with it
whatWentWrong.lead: On 23 Sep a card marked 'do not fire today' was used within ninety minutes, and it dropped the Vikings D/ST instead of the player it named. That's why the Tuten card above starts with 'Only if'.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The Bateman card was a fallback. It was used anyway, and the drop was the Vikings D/ST rather than Coleman. You had no defence until the Lions went in at 04:25 UTC on the 24th.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Tuten card is a swap, not a drop, so the worst case is four projected points, not an empty slot. Still, only move Tuten in if Friday's report actually rules Warren out.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It turns out ESPN made that drop automatically because of the roster limit. Then this is a platform problem, not a lesson about fallback cards. Three runs in a row with fallback cards left alone would also say the 23rd was a one-off. This is the second run in a row.

roster.footnote: Nothing kicks off before Sunday 11:00 Mexico City. All nine slots are filled. Grades use footballdb's 2026 points-allowed table (standard scoring, two games, 1st = fewest allowed). That's a thin sample, so read them as a lean, not a verdict. Kicker and D/ST aren't graded.

starting.name: Jaylen Warren
starting.detail: PIT · vs CIN · SUN 11:00 · QUESTIONABLE · limited Wednesday and Thursday with the shoulder. Dowdle didn't practise Thursday (Steelers Depot). Aaron Rodgers throwing. Starts unless Friday rules him out.

starting.name: Justin Jefferson
starting.detail: MIN · at TB · SUN 14:05 · Kyler Murray cleared the concussion protocol and starts (Vikings.com). It's a new pairing: Murray has played 11 snaps as a Viking. Stud, starts.

starting.name: Garrett Wilson
starting.detail: NYJ · at DET · SUN 11:00 · The Jets are down to four healthy receivers: Omar Cooper Jr. has a high ankle sprain, Arian Smith is out for the season, and Adonai Mitchell was added to Thursday's report with a finger injury (The Jet Press). TE Mason Taylor is unlikely to play (Last Word On Sports). The targets are concentrating on Wilson. Your Lions defence faces him.

starting.name: Jalen Coker
starting.detail: CAR · at CLE · SUN 11:00 · QUESTIONABLE · limited Wednesday with the ankle (Athlon). I couldn't find Thursday's Panthers report. Bryce Young throwing. Cleveland have allowed the 5th-most WR points. That matchup was the one gap in his thesis, and it's now filled.

starting.name: Isaiah Likely
starting.detail: NYG · vs TEN · SUN 11:00 · Jameis Winston throwing. Harbaugh confirmed Dart misses the rest of the regular season (Giants.com). Likely wasn't on Wednesday's report. Nabers was limited with the shoulder.

starting.detail: DET · vs NYJ · SUN 11:00 · The Jets offence is depleted: four healthy WRs, Mitchell limited (finger), TE Mason Taylor unlikely (The Jet Press, Last Word On Sports). This morning's source had them FantasyPros DST6.

starting.detail: SF · vs ARI · SUN 14:05 · PFN's updated Week 3 board (22 Sep) still ranks him K17, with McPherson K1 and Smack K4. ESPN has him at 9.4, above both. The seat changed on 23 Sep, so hold. See Worth a look.

bench.detail: JAX · vs NE · SUN 11:00 · I didn't check the Jaguars' Thursday report. No ESPN tag. Leads Jacksonville's backs in snaps and carries (SI). Warren's cover.

bench.name: Terry McLaurin
bench.detail: WSH · vs SEA · SUN 11:00 · Marcus Mariota starts while Jayden Daniels gets opinions on his elbow (NFL.com). Seattle have allowed the fewest WR points in the league. It's right that he's on the bench.

bench.detail: CHI · vs PHI · MON 18:15 · ESPN tags him QUESTIONABLE, but the reporting I found doesn't name an injury. BearsTalk (23 Sep) expect Chicago to lean on the backs with Case Keenum likely at QB.

bench.name: Denzel Boston
bench.detail: CLE · vs CAR · SUN 11:00 · Not re-researched this run. This morning: 93% of snaps, 7-154-2 on 11 targets (Heavy). Coker has the flex by projection.

bench.detail: BAL · at DAL · SUN 14:25 · Zay Flowers didn't practise Wednesday and SI (24 Sep) calls him unlikely to play, so Bateman's 93%-snap Week 2 role probably continues. He still can't get into this lineup.

worthALook.name: Evan McPherson
worthALook.lead: The kicker comparison, answered hold again. The two sources still disagree about Pineiro.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: PFN's updated Week 3 board (Katz, 22 Sep): McPherson K1 at Pittsburgh, Trey Smack K4 (5 of 5 on field goals so far, including a 59-yarder), Pineiro K17. ESPN's snapshot has Pineiro 9.4, Smack 8.7 and McPherson 7.4. Both are free agents here.

case.label: Why hold
case.body: Pineiro came in on 23 Sep, so changing him now would be the second change to that seat in a week. It would also cost a roster spot you don't have spare.

case.label: When to act
case.body: 30 September, when the churn window closes, if Pineiro finishes Week 3 outside the top twenty kickers while McPherson or Smack finishes top five.

doNotChase.name: Dalton Schultz
doNotChase.lead: The market is right about him, and it doesn't matter here.

case.label: The role
case.body: 12 catches for 140 yards against Cincinnati. SI (23 Sep) say the signs point to Nico Collins missing another game, which leaves Houston leaning on Schultz.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Chem has one tight-end slot, and Likely holds it. The flex takes RB/WR only. A second tight end scores you zero.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely showing up on a Giants injury report. He wasn't on Wednesday's.

doNotChase.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
doNotChase.lead: Plays tonight. However he does, the structural reason he's gone doesn't change.

case.label: The fact
case.body: Michael Penix Jr. returns at quarterback tonight at Green Bay. Lindy's (24 Sep) call Pitts a matchup streamer whose upside improves with Penix.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One tight-end slot, held by Likely; the flex is RB/WR only. In Week 2 he played 26 of 69 snaps, behind two back-up tight ends.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely getting hurt. Separately, the log grades this decline WRONG if Pitts outscores Likely in two of the next three weeks.

doNotChase.name: Jaxson Dart
doNotChase.lead: Still the biggest ownership anomaly on this wire, and his ownership is falling for a reason.

case.label: The fact
case.body: John Harbaugh confirmed Dart misses the rest of the 2026 regular season; Jameis Winston starts (Giants.com).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing. You start Josh Allen in a one-quarterback league.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage. Only two weeks of data, which is thin, but the tool's answer stands and nobody went looking for a reason to disagree.

settled.title: 'Coker isn't on the Panthers' Wednesday report' (24 Sep, 04:40Z)
settled.result: Wrong: he was limited Wednesday (Athlon, CBS). It cost nothing because he starts either way, but the roster note was false.

settled.title: Add the Bengals D/ST, drop Coleman (23 Sep, 22:10Z)
settled.result: It fell apart on its own condition before anyone acted. Replaced by the Lions card, which you made at 22:25 with Coleman as the drop.

settled.title: Publish the Bateman add as a fallback card (23 Sep, 13:05Z)
settled.result: Used within ninety minutes, and it took the Vikings D/ST with it. Still the reason today's fallback card starts 'Only if'.

settled.title: Hold Isaiah Likely through the Giants' quarterback change (22 Sep)
settled.result: Dart is out for the regular season (Harbaugh, Giants.com). Winston is the settled starter and Likely the settled TE1. The target clause is graded after Sunday.
